note: The exact perturbation targets, committed before the seed is sampled and hashed into the registration. Every rule here is deterministic and seed-independent, so the demonstration cannot be steered after scores are known.

many.method: confusable substitution of the first eligible character in every tenth scored token
many.rationale: A token editing rate of about 0.1, which is the rate the NDSS 2026 character-level attack paper uses. One character changes almost nothing; this is what an actual attack looks like.
